title: Top K Frequent Elements

tests.label: every value once, k = all of them
most frequent isn't the largest value

tests.argsPy:
r = rng(347)
nums = []
for v in range(-10**4, 10**4 + 1):
    nums += [v] * r.randint(1, 3)
top = [r.randint(-10**4, 10**4) for _ in range(40)]
top = list(dict.fromkeys(top))[:10]
for i, v in enumerate(top):
    nums += [v] * (3000 + 500 * i)
r.shuffle(nums)
args = [nums, 10]
tests.label: large: 20,001 distinct values, k = 10

tests.argsPy:
r = rng(3471)
vals = list(range(-10**4, 10**4 + 1))
r.shuffle(vals)
nums = []
for i, v in enumerate(vals):
    nums += [v] * (r.randint(3, 6) if i < 8000 else r.randint(1, 2))
r.shuffle(nums)
args = [nums, 8000]
tests.label: large: k = 8,000
